verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a per-issue ignore/suppress mechanism (snyk-docs-5) and reference broader 'Policy management' (snyk-docs-32) plus risk-based prioritization (snyk-docs-4) that could reduce noise, but there is no detailed documentation of a baseline feature (e.g., marking all existing findings as baseline in bulk) or false-positive workflow, and no independent/community evidence confirming this works well in practice — in fact community comments (snyk-comm-9, snyk-comm-10) suggest noise/triage remains a pain point. Missing for 10: explicit baseline/bulk-ignore documentation, false-positive marking workflow, and independent confirmation that ignored issues stay suppressed across scans.
